correctness.rationale: For the one-dimensional aligned two-cell symmetric Nitsche form with 0<kappa<1, gamma>0, p=1 or 2, varying the common trace reduces nonnegativity to delta>=z^T H^{-1}z in the derivative variables. The p=1 energy matrix gives T1=(1+gamma)/(kappa(1+gamma)+gamma). Independently rebuilt the p=2 4x4 Gram matrix from the integral and face jump and calculated T2=N/Q, matching the supplied positive polynomials. The difference p^2+gamma^{-1}-T_p is strictly positive at each kappa>0, while the kappa->0 limit is p^2+gamma^{-1}; hence uniform nonnegativity iff delta>=p^2+1/gamma, with individual-cut positive definiteness at the uniform boundary. These are exact algebraic arguments for the isolated model; no uniform coercivity constant/full assembled mesh is claimed.
